definitions.gloss: to set upon; to attack suddenly
definitions.explanation: To rush at and attack someone or something, as an animal, an attacker or a natural force does. Also used of feelings or sensations that suddenly overwhelm a person: {睡魔|すいま}が{襲|おそ}いかかる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{襲|おそ}いかかった。
⟦ライオン→ライオン：05197_raion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧シマウマ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{襲|おそ}いかかる。
examples.english: The lion pounces on the zebra.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{襲|おそ}いかかってきた。
examples.english: As we walked along the mountain path, fierce rain and wind suddenly came down on us.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{襲|おそ}う→襲う：01915_osou⟧ "to attack" and ⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧, which adds the sense of throwing oneself at a target. More vivid than ⟦{襲|おそ}う→襲う：01915_osou⟧ alone, and common in news reports and stories.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive: the target takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{襲|おそ}いかかる (unlike ⟦{襲|おそ}う→襲う：01915_osou⟧, which takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{襲|おそ}いかかる: to pounce on prey
- {襲|おそ}いかかってくる: to come at someone
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{襲|おそ}いかかる: anxiety overwhelms one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飛|と}び{掛|か}かる→飛び掛かる：30267_tobikakaru⟧: to leap at — stresses the jump
